title: Region masks per question-unit (papers/_work/<paperId>/mask.json)
description: Gen-3 MASK contract. For each SPLIT unit, labels its page area into regions the generator acts on. Non-destructive metadata in paper-normalised coords (0-1) — the crop keeps everything; the generator decides at export. Compact drops writing-space; non-compact re-rules it; answer-structure and content are kept in BOTH modes.

spaceHeight.description: Total writing-space height in points (sum of writing-space region heights x page hpt). The generator re-rules to this in non-compact mode.

label.description: content=keep always; writing-space=drop compact/re-rule non-compact; dead-space=drop always; answer-structure=grids/tables/MC bubbles/number-planes, keep in BOTH modes, never re-rule over.
